task: Update the CMS-V2 loading screen by fully replacing the previous Alex Warnes orbit spinner with the Trhino CodePen project (jOQJPQ) with dual light/dark mode institutional theming.
lessons_learned: Trhino CodePen beam aperture mechanic requires top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, right: 0, margin: auto for absolute vertical and horizontal centering so that initial thin horizontal beam (3px height) expands symmetrically upward and downward.
Tailwind class 'relative' on an absolutely positioned animated aperture element overrides 'position: absolute' due to CSS cascade, throwing off vertical alignment in flex containers.
Institutional BukSU palette (Royal Blue #1A448A and Academic Gold #E5A823) delivers a distinctive collegiate look across both dark and light portals.
